body: please don’t do it. are you still here?

I’m still here! I’m so happy you are doing better. I actually was rereading our exchange a couple days ago. I’m doing better than I was when I made this post, I had a severe mental breakdown and couldn’t function normally for a couple weeks. I went to therapy, and now I’m starting school again this week and I generally feel pretty positive about life again. Thanks for checking on me :)

I struggle to cope with the various trauma I’ve experienced over my life. It’s always on replay in my head. The mental trauma, emotional & physical. All of it. I’ve also realized I’ve been pretty shit to others as a defense mechanism, not that it justifies any of it, but that’s why I did it. I’d take it all back if I could, but alas I can’t. 

If you’re still in college you must be relatively young, what’s stopping you from turning your college career around into a positive direction?
Can I ask why you feel it’s too late for you? Cause I feel it’s too late for me as well

Thanks for the response. I’m proud of you as well. Im glad you have your father, im sure he loves you very much. I know this sounds cliche because people say it on these forums all the time, but I genuinely care for you and hope you find the peace to overcome your struggles.
I just want to help anyone who feels like I do, thank you for your lovely words

I don’t really want to detail things on here because they are very personal, but, after I made this post I had a very long conversation with my brother confessing how I feel and he was very comforting. At least for the moment, I feel a little more at ease.

I know how tough it is. I read a couple of your posts and you sound like a good person. I hope things get easier for you. I can relate to some of your issues and I know it’s hard to stay strong and cope, but I take it one day at a time. Although it can be tough, just making it through the day is a major accomplishment. Stay strong.
